gloss: to cover one's ears; to refuse to listen

definitions.gloss: to cover one's ears; to block one's ears
definitions.explanation: To physically cover or plug one's ears to block out noise.

definitions.gloss: to refuse to listen; to turn a deaf ear
definitions.explanation: To deliberately ignore or refuse to hear information, criticism, or advice. A figurative use meaning to close oneself off from unwanted input.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}いだ。
examples.english: I covered my ears against the loud noise.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{怖|こわ}がって{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}いだ。
examples.english: The children were scared of the thunder and covered their ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{爆発音|ばくはつおん}→爆発音：28327_bakuhatsuon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごくて→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}いだ。
examples.english: The fireworks were so loud that I instinctively covered my ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ。
examples.english: To turn a deaf ear to criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}いで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not refuse to listen to inconvenient truths.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}ぎ⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of constantly ignoring the advice of those around him, he made a big mistake.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal, physical action of covering one's ears. Sense 2 is figurative, meaning to deliberately avoid hearing something unpleasant. The figurative use is common in discussions about willful ignorance or avoidance of criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ (to turn a deaf ear to criticism)
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ (to ignore advice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧: to lend an ear, to listen — the opposite action
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to refuse to listen — similar figurative meaning
